coordinate_system.centre_pattern: Each depth5/10/15/20mm: centre and±5mm x/y; these centre offsets are distinct from fixed5mm tip spacing

instruments.ideal_gain_definition: Physical active-probe output=unloaded tip voltage/attenuation; scope display=physical output*scope display ratio. This is ideal gain bookkeeping, not a loaded prediction.
instruments.load_scope: ETA input R/C would load the phantom; scope R/C is downstream of the active probe and has not been assembled as a phantom-parallel load.
instruments.status: user-supplied specifications; actual switches/menus unconfirmed; unloaded calculation only

interpolation_policy.XY: Bilinear actual physical coordinates, no XY extrapolation
interpolation_policy.Z: Exact plane or same-layer linear bracket; never cross a material interface
interpolation_policy.failure_policy: Unavailable row, never silently substitute nearest/cross-layer values

normalization_scope: Original native fixed1Vpp carrier phasors; no burden scaling silently applied
